_about: Military Warehouses' sun (the owner, 2026-11-13: "military warehouses doesn't have good sun", "you cannot look at that direction at all"): the port's environment has god rays of intensity 1.0 at attenuation 1.0 and lens flares x2. 0.26g's rays are colour x intensity x (1 - screen distance to the sun)^attenuation x the open sky between the pixel and the sun (god_rays.ps, god_rays_mask.ps), added to the frame before the tone curve: half a screen height away from an open sun that is 0.23 here, 0.05 on a stock day map (level_03: 0.65 at 2.6) and 0.01 on Vostok v0.11, the port that has this same day weather (the same sun: 38.0 degrees up, azimuth 219.7, intensity 1.29) with rays 0.2 at 3.0 and flares x0.7. Military Warehouses takes those three values of Vostok v0.11, in its Team Deathmatch project and in Free for All's copy. Sun, sky, fog, bloom and shadows are untouched. Visual only. Experimental Pool, Training Camp and the three STALKER maps not played have the same three values as before; they are not changed here.
